question_text: Construct an SQL query using Buyer(BuyerID, FirstName, Surname) and Invoice(InvoiceID, BuyerID, InvoiceDate). Return first name, surname and invoice date for buyer Mira Shah.
adaptation_rationale: Preserves two-table join/filter reasoning; new schema avoids reserved ORDER identifier and source sample’s OrdDate/OrderDate mismatch.
solution: SELECT b.FirstName,b.Surname,i.InvoiceDate FROM Buyer AS b JOIN Invoice AS i ON b.BuyerID=i.BuyerID WHERE b.FirstName='Mira' AND b.Surname='Shah';

marking_points.criterion: Filters both FirstName=Mira and Surname=Shah using AND.
